hook.title: Turn camera roll chaos into dumps
hook.description: Say goodbye to scrolling through thousands of shots. PicDump picks the best photos of your days and trips, paced with flow.
hook.point1: Film looks, borders and IG / TikTok sizes
hook.point2: Collage layouts, one swipe at a time

privacy.title: Picked on your phone, not in the cloud
privacy.description: Photo picks, search and dumps run on your phone. PicDump does not upload your photos to curate them.
privacy.point1: Photo access lets it find your standout moments
